text: It is not even clear that intelligence has any long-term survival value.
author: Stephen Hawking
visual_brief: A precise orthographic engineering drawing of a horseshoe crab carapace in top and sectional views, rendered with technical cross-hatching, datum lines, and dimension arrows marking its completely unchanged structural tolerances across hundreds of millions of years.
alt: Orthographic engineering schematic of an ancient horseshoe crab's unchanging shell
